## Palette checklist

Skip this section if the pull request adds no palette.

- [ ] One palette, in `themes/palettes/<catalog>/<name>.toml`, where the file name matches `meta.name`
- [ ] Its catalog folder has a `[[catalog]]` table in `themes/ttheme-marketplace.toml`
- [ ] `meta.signature` names three slots that resolve to three different colors
- [ ] `meta.booru` is a character tag with posts on danbooru, or is left out
- [ ] `meta.ansi_source` names the real base scheme; its license:
- [ ] Color values and post numbers only — no images, links or any other asset
- [ ] `mise run ci` passes
